campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from Clemson University Housing & Dining's official building pages. Clemson publishes a room footprint for most buildings (usually stated as including the closet or entry space) plus measured desk, dresser, closet, window and bed-frame sizes, so most rooms here come straight from those pages at high confidence; Clemson notes exact measurements may vary. Suites and apartments are modeled per bedroom so occupant counts and layouts match cleanly. Residence-hall beds are XL twin; the Douthit Hills West apartments use full-size beds instead, which is flagged on those rooms because Twin XL bedding will not fit.
